evals.prompt: Map this codebase for me, I'm new here and need to understand how it's put together before touching anything.
evals.expected_output: The script is run; the map at docs/engineering/architecture.md lists components (pages, components, stores, router, root files) with afferent and efferent counts equal to the script output, traces the Home → ProductCard → catalog store → fetch path naming files, lists VITE_API_URL as an integration signal, states the static-import limits, lists the files read, and contains no recommendation.
assertions: scripts/map_codebase.py is run before any component is described
Every component row cites at least one path and its coupling numbers match the script output
A traced path names src/pages/Home.vue, src/components/ProductCard.vue and src/stores/catalog.ts in order, ending at the fetch call
VITE_API_URL appears as an integration point configured by environment
The map states that framework auto-imports and dynamic imports are not counted
No sentence contains should, could or consider, and no code file was modified

evals.expected_output: The script reports a likely monorepo (workspaces packages/*); the skill stops and asks which package to map, recommending one, before reading any code.
assertions: The user is asked which package or directory to map before any map is written
The question includes a recommended answer
No docs/engineering/ file is created before the answer
The reply is in English, the language of the prompt

evals.prompt: Map the code. There is already an ARCHITECTURE.md registered as our architecture document.
evals.expected_output: The map is written to docs/engineering/codebase-map.md, ARCHITECTURE.md is untouched, and disagreements between the specification and the code appear under Observations as facts.
assertions: The output file is docs/engineering/codebase-map.md, not docs/engineering/architecture.md
The registered specification file is byte-identical after the run
Any disagreement between specification and code is stated as an observation with locations, without a recommendation
